contracts.asserts: Signed deltas, rounding and arithmetic boundaries

Independent histories, contact reset, suppression, generation changes and numeric-only state-transition logs without runtime device labels or no-op repeats; touch release survives enabling suppression after a forwarded press on both streams; consumed press/repeat/release pairs, disabling, generation resets, sync boundaries and independent listener records; 48 repeat/policy/generation cases retain release ownership for both button kinds/listeners, four nonzero values, no reset/before-repeat/mid-repeat reset; discarded new presses never earn forwarding credit; 24 overlapping button/listener scenarios assert each ordered edge, both release orders, retained second release across generation changes and post-release retirement

Settings read/type failures, paired application, collision detection without device-specific keys, and latest registry callback precedence across an older paused read; same owner fixture runs host stand-ins or real Zephyr mutex/thread boundary

limits: Host stand-ins and controlled native registry/device/setter do not prove persistent storage, arbitrary interleavings, Studio or split/physical delivery. Native execution separately exercises actual kernel mutexes and threads.

execution.default: quick: every host behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once; offline-admission and coverage-validator units once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same host scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants; native and supported-core integration use separate entries
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Exact supported core/dependency pins, clean sources, missing inputs, safe nonoverlapping project paths, west/config metadata separation, fresh outputs outside original workspace/dependency roots including symlink aliases, and pinned custom-settings archive; identity bypass negative control

Same emitted owner fixture:24 normal overlapping scenarios pass; test-only shared button history fails exact ownership assertion; emission rejects existing files, symlink aliases and unknown selectors without modifying source

Actual full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially missing gcov reports with recording compiler/gcov tools; each gated range requires executable lines; valid counts and unexecuted line/branch failures retained

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

kernel.asserts: Actual Zephyr mutex contention serializes an older paused read before a newer callback, leaving the newer pair applied; same binary repeats three times; test-only lock bypass must fail the exact stale-value assertion three times
kernel.limits: Controlled registry, device and setter; no persistence, Studio, physical transport or exhaustive scheduling claim
